BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Biology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Specimen Collection and Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
